component.name: ProvenanceEF2
component.summary: Star Trek: Voyager — Elite Force II, natively on Linux

description.p: ProvenanceEF2 runs Star Trek: Voyager — Elite Force II natively on Linux: the id Tech 3 engine lineage through OpenMoHAA, the reconstructed game and client-game modules, and a from-scratch Vulkan renderer — every function held to a witness in the retail binaries.

The retail game data is not included and cannot be downloaded here. An installation of the original game (retail CD or the GOG release) is required. Point the game at it with +set fs_basepath /path/to/install, or put your retail base/ directory under ~/.local/share/provenanceef2/.

ul.li: Vulkan renderer, widescreen and arbitrary resolutions
Keyboard and mouse keep the retail layout
Self-contained: no distribution packages needed beyond a Vulkan driver
